title: M3 Max graphics are on by default in the kernel branch
summary: Two merged changes switch on the display and graphics of M3 Max MacBook Pros, at 120 Hz.

topics.angle: One more chip with its graphics on.
The M3 Max, and a longer sleep.

claims.text: The 16-inch M3 Max has its built-in display and graphics on by default, at 120 hertz.
The 14-inch model with the same chip got the same days earlier.
On that 16-inch Mac, external displays stay off for now.
Asleep, an M3 Pro went from about 2.6 watts to about 1.4.
Daniel Lemky’s commits are the base of the 16-inch work, and Chris Kearney’s of the 14-inch work.

to_find: Someone using a 16-inch M3 Max day to day
would_change: A report of either Mac failing on the published kernel.
